Hi Sam / Emily,

Thanks again for the call today, great to learn more about Horizon's personalization use cases and the latency/cost constraints you mentioned. As discussed, next step would be a 60-minute technical deep dive with our solutions and infra engineers to go through model routing, KV caching, and deployment options.

To make this easy for a distributed team, we typically propose a rotating set of recurring slots so burden of early/late meetings is shared across regions. Below are three weekly slot options (all in UTC for clarity):

- Option A (Americas-friendly): Tue 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT / 13:00 ET)
- Option B (EMEA-friendly): Wed 15:00 UTC (16:00 CET / 11:00 ET)
- Option C (APAC-friendly): Thu 00:00 UTC (08:00 SGT / 01:00 CET)

Proposal: we rotate the meeting weekly (A / B / C), so each region hosts a convenient slot every third week. If that works, we can lock a recurring invite and adjust if needed.

Please reply with preferred initial slot (A/B/C), any hard constraints for your team, and whether you prefer a 60 or 90 minute session. I attached a quick availability grid (availability-grid.csv) to capture who should join.

Agenda (proposed):
- 10m: intros + goals
- 30-60m: technical deep dive (routing, caching, quantization profiles)
- 10-20m: integration and next steps + Q&A

If Calendly is easier, here's a direct booking link: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/technical-deep-dive

Cheers,
